#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    stringstream ss(line);
    int n;
    ss >> n;
    const int MOD = 1000000007;

    vector<int> previous(n + 1, 0);
    long long sum = 0;

    for (int row = 0; row <= n; row++) {
        previous[row] = 1;
        if ((row & 1) == 1) {
            sum = (sum + 1) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int col = 1; col <= n; col++) {
        vector<int> current(n + 1, 0);
        for (int row = col; row <= n; row++) {
            int above = (row == col) ? 0 : current[row - 1];
            current[row] = (previous[row] + above) % MOD;
            if (((row + col) & 1) == 1) {
                sum = (sum + current[row]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        previous = current;
    }

    cout << sum << endl;

    return 0;
}
